claim: For the resonant zero-temperature Lorentzian damped Jaynes--Cummings model used by Xu, Yang, and Feng, let \(\Gamma>0\) be the reservoir spectral width and \(\gamma_0>0\) the Markovian decay scale. In the strong-memory regime \(\gamma_0>\Gamma/2\), put \[\kappa=\sqrt{2\gamma_0\Gamma-\Gamma^2}.\]The optimized Breuer--Laine--Piilo trace distance is the excited-state amplitude magnitude \[|b(t)|=e^{-\Gamma t/2}\left|\cos(\kappa t/2)+\frac{\Gamma}{\kappa}\sin(\kappa t/2)\right|.\]Its positive-information-flow maxima occur exactly at \(t_n=2\pi n/\kappa\), \(n\ge1\), with heights \[|b(t_n)|=e^{-\pi\Gamma n/\kappa}.\]Therefore the infinite-time BLP non-Markovianity has the closed form \[\mathcal N_{\mathrm{BLP}}=\frac{1}{e^{\pi\Gamma/\kappa}-1}\]for \(\gamma_0>\Gamma/2\), while \(\mathcal N_{\mathrm{BLP}}=0\) for \(\gamma_0\le\Gamma/2\). Writing \(\varepsilon=2\gamma_0/\Gamma-1\), the onset is beyond all algebraic orders: \[\mathcal N_{\mathrm{BLP}}\sim e^{-\pi/\sqrt{\varepsilon}}\qquad(\varepsilon\downarrow0),\]and the zero extension to \(\varepsilon\le0\) is \(C^\infty\) with every derivative equal to zero at the threshold. In the opposite strong-coupling limit \(r=\gamma_0/\Gamma\to\infty\), \[\mathcal N_{\mathrm{BLP}}=\frac{\sqrt{2r-1}}{\pi}-\frac12+\frac{\pi}{12\sqrt{2r-1}}+O(r^{-3/2}).\]Thus the canonical resonant Lorentzian model has an exact geometric revival spectrum, an ultra-flat onset of information backflow at the Markovian boundary, and a square-root growth law at strong coupling.

integrity.novelty_scope: Closed geometric BLP measure for the resonant Lorentzian model together with its beyond-all-orders threshold onset and strong-coupling asymptotic.
integrity.ownership_basis: Mathematical bibliographic classification of quantum non-Markovianity lists Quantum information, communication, networks (81P45) as primary MSC.
integrity.prior_work_preserved: The BLP measure, the Lorentzian model, the resonant optimizing trace distance, zero minima, and sum-over-maxima representation are all credited to the cited sources.
integrity.source_date_basis: The BLP source manuscript arXiv:0908.0238 was first public on 2009-08-03; the resonant optimization source arXiv:0912.2879 followed on 2009-12-15.

scientific_limitations: The closed form is specific to the resonant zero-temperature Lorentzian amplitude-damping model.
The detuned problem does not reduce to the same zero-minimum geometric revival sum.
The strong-coupling expansion is a statement about the exact model and does not extend the physical validity of microscopic approximations.
An equivalent closed sum may exist in later unindexed applications of the canonical model.
title: Closed BLP non-Markovianity and an ultra-flat memory onset in the resonant damped Jaynes–Cummings model
